title: Microsoft Start (News)
why: The news feed app. Nothing else depends on it.

title: MSN Weather
why: The weather app. Nothing else depends on it.

title: MSN Money, Sports, Food, Health, Travel and Translator
why: Old MSN apps that Microsoft stopped. Usually already gone.

title: Microsoft News
why: The older news app. Nothing else depends on it.

title: Bing Search
why: Adds Bing web results to Start and taskbar search. The Optimize page can switch those results off without removing it.
breaksIfRemoved: Web results disappear from Start and taskbar search.

title: Widgets feed
why: Provides the news feed of the Widgets board.
breaksIfRemoved: The Widgets feed stops.

title: Widgets platform
why: The runtime of the Widgets board.
breaksIfRemoved: Windows Widgets stops working.

title: Microsoft 365 hub
why: A launcher for Microsoft 365. The Office apps you installed are separate.

title: OneNote (Store app)
why: The Store version of OneNote.
breaksIfRemoved: Notes not yet synced to your account can be lost with the app.

title: Sway
why: A web presentation app nobody depends on.

title: Power BI, Journal and Office Lens
why: Rarely used extras.

title: Microsoft 365 Companions
why: Mini apps for Microsoft 365 Business accounts.
breaksIfRemoved: The Calendar, Files and People companions of a Microsoft 365 Business account.

title: Outlook (new)
why: The default mail app of recent Windows 11. Remove it only if you read your mail elsewhere.
breaksIfRemoved: The default mail handler and the mail and calendar of accounts set up only here.

title: Mail and Calendar (classic)
why: The older mail app, no longer supported since the end of 2024.
breaksIfRemoved: Mail, Calendar and People for accounts set up only here.

title: People
why: The contacts hub that comes with Mail and Calendar. It cannot be reinstalled from the Store.
breaksIfRemoved: The contacts of Mail and Calendar.

title: Microsoft Teams
why: The Teams app that comes with Windows. Remove it only if you do not join meetings with it.
breaksIfRemoved: Teams meetings and chat on this PC.

title: Microsoft Teams (old personal chat)
why: The old consumer chat, replaced by the new Teams.

title: Skype (Store app)
why: Retired by Microsoft in 2025.

title: Messaging, Mobile Plans, Wallet and GroupMe
why: Old phone and wallet apps, mostly absent on Windows 11.

title: Old Windows Phone components
why: Leftovers of Windows Phone with no use today.

title: Phone Link
why: Connects your Android or iPhone to the PC.
breaksIfRemoved: Phone notifications, messages, photos and calls on the PC.

title: Cross Device Experience
why: The phone integration used by Phone Link, File Explorer and Camera.
breaksIfRemoved: Phone integration in File Explorer and Camera.

title: Phone Link calling
why: The calling window of Phone Link.
breaksIfRemoved: Calls from Phone Link.

title: Microsoft Family Safety
why: The parental control app.
breaksIfRemoved: Screen time and content limits on child accounts.

title: Quick Assist
why: The remote help tool that family and IT support use.
breaksIfRemoved: Giving or receiving remote help with Quick Assist.

title: Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool
why: Used in support sessions.

title: Clipchamp
why: The video editor that comes with Windows.

title: Media Player
why: The default player for local music and video.
breaksIfRemoved: Local audio and video have no default player until you pick another one.

title: Movies & TV
why: The older video player and store.

title: Photos
why: The default picture viewer. The image codecs are kept in any case.
breaksIfRemoved: Pictures open in nothing until you pick another viewer.

title: Photos media engine
why: A component of Photos and its video editor. Remove it only with Photos.

title: Camera
why: The webcam app. Other apps use the camera without it.
breaksIfRemoved: The Camera app.

title: Sound Recorder
why: The voice recorder.

title: Clock
why: Alarms, timer, world clock and focus sessions.
breaksIfRemoved: The alarms, timers and world clock.

title: Dolby Access
why: Audio enhancement licensed to some hardware. The sources disagree on whether it is safe.
breaksIfRemoved: Dolby Atmos or Digital Plus sound on PCs licensed for it.

title: Notepad
why: The default text editor of Windows 11.
breaksIfRemoved: The default editor for text files.

title: Paint
why: The classic picture editor. Not the same as Paint 3D.
breaksIfRemoved: The quick picture editor.

title: Paint 3D
why: The discontinued 3D version of Paint. It cannot be reinstalled from the Store.

title: Snipping Tool
why: Screenshots and screen recording (Win+Shift+S).
breaksIfRemoved: Screenshots, annotations and screen recording.

title: Calculator
why: The default calculator.
breaksIfRemoved: The calculator and the Calculator key.

title: Sticky Notes
why: Your sticky notes.
breaksIfRemoved: Notes not yet synced to your account can be lost with the app.

title: Microsoft To Do
why: A task list whose data lives in your account.

title: Whiteboard
why: A collaboration board.

title: Remote Desktop (Store app)
why: The Store remote desktop client. The built-in mstsc is separate.
breaksIfRemoved: Connections saved in the Store client.

title: Power Automate
why: A desktop automation tool, rarely used.

title: Dev Home
why: Developer settings: sudo, long paths, Dev Drive, Git status in Explorer. Developers may want it.
breaksIfRemoved: The Dev Home and Advanced Settings toggles.

title: Feedback Hub
why: Sends feedback to Microsoft.

title: Get Help
why: Some Windows troubleshooters and support links open it.
breaksIfRemoved: The network troubleshooter of the tray icon and the support links of the maker.

title: Tips
why: The tips and get-started app. It cannot be reinstalled from the Store.

title: Windows Maps
why: The maps app. Microsoft removed it from the Store, so it cannot be reinstalled from there.
breaksIfRemoved: Offline maps you downloaded.

title: PC Manager and Network Speed Test
why: Optional utilities from Microsoft.

title: 3D Viewer, 3D Builder, Print 3D and Mixed Reality Portal
why: Discontinued 3D and VR apps. The Mixed Reality Portal is only needed with a headset.

title: Cortana
why: The discontinued assistant.

title: Minecraft for Windows (old edition)
why: A game you may own.
breaksIfRemoved: The game and its local worlds.

title: Microsoft Solitaire Collection
why: Card games with ads.

title: Xbox app
why: Needed to install and launch Game Pass PC games.
breaksIfRemoved: Installing or signing in to Game Pass PC games.

title: Xbox Game Bar
why: The Win+G overlay, game capture and performance widgets.
breaksIfRemoved: The Win+G overlay and game capture. Links to the Game Bar open a Store page.

title: Xbox Console Companion (old)
why: The discontinued predecessor of the Xbox app.

title: Xbox speech to text
why: An accessibility overlay used by some games.
breaksIfRemoved: Speech transcription in the party chat of some games.

title: Gaming Services
why: The backbone of Game Pass and Store game installs.
breaksIfRemoved: Installing and updating Game Pass and Store PC games.

title: Promoted casual games
why: Games that Windows or the maker of the PC installed as advertising (Candy Crush and the like).

title: Promoted streaming, shopping and social apps
why: Apps such as Netflix, Prime Video, Instagram or TikTok that were installed as advertising.

title: Promoted editors and utilities
why: Third-party editors, PDF and zip tools installed as advertising.

title: HP apps
why: Apps of the maker. Some are hardware tools (power, diagnostics, privacy controls). Windows Update can reinstall them.
breaksIfRemoved: The maker power, diagnostics and privacy controls of an HP laptop.

title: Dell, Lenovo and LG apps
why: Apps of the maker that manage drivers, battery modes and warranty.
breaksIfRemoved: Driver updates, battery modes and support tools of the maker.

title: Copilot
why: The Copilot app. It can be reinstalled from the Store.

title: Copilot+ AI hub
why: The hub of the Copilot+ PC features.

title: Windows AI models
why: On-device models used by Recall, Click to Do, camera effects and text recognition on Copilot+ PCs.
breaksIfRemoved: Camera effects, text recognition and image search on a Copilot+ PC.

title: Microsoft 365 AI helpers
why: Background parts of the AI actions of Microsoft 365.

title: Handwriting recognition
why: The recognizers behind pen and touch handwriting.
breaksIfRemoved: Converting pen and touch handwriting to text.
